zh.name: 教会山
zh.description: 冰川侵蚀留下孤立山体，层状岩壁与狭长山脚随观赏角度改变轮廓。
zh.transport: 从格伦达菲厄泽镇向西走 54 号公路，在瀑布停车区停靠，从标示步道看山。
zh.photo: 从瀑布步道把山峰与水流置于同一画面。
zh.management: Grundarfjörður 市镇发布到访和步道信息。山脚的通行以地主管理和入口标示为准。
zh.access: 可在公共观景路径远观。停车收费及登山通行依入口规定。
zh.visit: 短停以山脚和瀑布观景为主；登顶属于另一项行程，请先查当地限制。

en.name: Kirkjufell
en.description: Glacial erosion helped isolate the mountain, and its layered cliffs and narrow base give it a different silhouette from either side.
en.transport: Drive west from Grundarfjörður on Route 54 and use the waterfall parking area for signed ground-level views.
en.photo: Frame the peak above the running water from the waterfall path.
en.management: Grundarfjörður municipality publishes local access information. Follow landowner instructions and signs at the mountain’s base.
en.access: View from public paths. Check posted parking charges and mountain access rules.
en.visit: For a short stop, use the low viewpoints and waterfall path. Check local restrictions separately for any summit trip.

zh.name: 格伦达瀑布
zh.description: 这道高瀑从格伦达菲厄泽东侧的高原崖缘跌入谷地，视觉重点是直落水柱和开阔牧地。
zh.transport: 由 54 号公路寻找格伦达瀑布停车入口，循标示步道进入谷地。
zh.photo: 在步道上用长焦压缩瀑布与崖壁的距离。
zh.management: Grundarfjörður 市镇提供瀑布游览信息；步道经过牧地，请遵守出入口告示。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Grundarfoss
en.description: This tall waterfall drops from the plateau east of Grundarfjörður, with a narrow plunge above open grazing land.
en.transport: Look for the Grundarfoss parking turnoff on Route 54 and follow the signed valley approach.
en.photo: Use a longer lens from the path to bring the cascade and cliff together.
en.management: Grundarfjörður municipality provides visitor information. The approach crosses grazing land, so follow signs at the entrance.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 狂战士熔岩原
zh.description: 约四千年前形成的熔岩地带，名字与《埃里人萨迦》中的狂战士故事有关。
zh.transport: 从北岸 54 号公路接入 558 号路，出发前查看路况与租车限制。
zh.photo: 在可以合法停车的位置拍低矮苔原与尖锐熔岩轮廓。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 558 号公路，Grundarfjörður 与 Stykkishólmur 之间

en.name: Berserkjahraun
en.description: The roughly 4,000-year-old lava field takes its name from a berserker story in Eyrbyggja Saga.
en.transport: Take Route 558 from the north-coast section of Route 54 after checking road conditions and rental restrictions.
en.photo: Use a legal pull-off to photograph the low moss and jagged lava.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 斯蒂基斯霍尔米港
zh.description: 天然港湾面向布雷扎湾，彩色房屋与码头反映了小镇的海运和贸易历史。
zh.transport: 走 58 号公路进入镇区，在港边公共停车位下车步行。
zh.photo: 从港湾对岸望向泊船和历史街区，留出水面反光。
zh.management: Sveitarfélagið Stykkishólmur 管理镇港公共空间。工作码头通行以港务标示为准。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Stykkishólmur Harbour
en.description: The natural harbour faces Breiðafjörður. Its colourful houses and quays reflect the town’s maritime and trading history.
en.transport: Follow Route 58 into town and continue on foot from public harbour parking.
en.photo: Look across the basin toward the boats and historic streets, allowing room for reflections.
en.management: Sveitarfélagið Stykkishólmur oversees the town harbour’s public areas. Follow harbour signs around working quays.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 苏甘迪斯岛灯塔
zh.description: 小岛由防波堤连到城镇，岩顶灯塔俯瞰港池与散布海湾的小岛。
zh.transport: 从斯蒂基斯霍尔米港步行越过防波堤，循阶梯登上岩顶。
zh.photo: 从步道高处回拍港口的船、水面和小镇屋顶。
zh.management: 斯蒂基斯霍尔米市镇提供港区和小岛的游览信息；灯塔外的步道以现场告示为准。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Súgandisey
en.description: A breakwater connects the rocky island to town. Its hilltop lighthouse overlooks the harbour and offshore islands.
en.transport: Walk across the breakwater from Stykkishólmur harbour and follow the stairs onto the rock.
en.photo: Turn back from the upper path to capture boats, water and town rooftops.
en.management: The municipality of Stykkishólmur provides harbour and island visitor information. Follow local signs around the lighthouse.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. לערי ריינהארט assumed (based on copyright claims).

zh.name: 赫尔加山
zh.description: 小山与冰岛萨迦、宗教遗迹和许愿传统有关，山顶能俯瞰北岸田野。
zh.transport: 在斯蒂基斯霍尔米以南自 58 号公路转入赫尔加山，按入口指示登山。
zh.photo: 在山顶现有步道构图，把田野与湾岸连成层次。
zh.management: 赫尔加山步道从当地农地进入，通行和费用以地主入口告示为准。
zh.access: 私地步道，以现场开放规定及费用为准。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Helgafell
en.description: The low hill is associated with Icelandic sagas, religious remains and a wishing tradition. Its summit overlooks the north-coast countryside.
en.transport: Turn off Route 58 south of Stykkishólmur and follow the landowner’s instructions at the trailhead.
en.photo: Frame the fields and bay in layers from the existing summit path.
en.management: The trail starts on local farmland. The landowner posts access and admission terms at the entrance.
en.access: Trail on private land. Check posted access terms and charges.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 德劳普赫利达山
zh.description: 不同颜色的岩层让山坡呈现赭黄、灰暗和红褐色斑带，适合从远处观察岩性变化。
zh.transport: 经斯蒂基斯霍尔米以南的公路接近，以合法停车点远望山体。
zh.photo: 用长焦将抽象色带与山脚地形放进同一幅画面。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: Stykkishólmur 南侧，近 54 号公路

en.name: Drápuhlíðarfjall
en.description: Rock layers give the slope bands of ochre, grey and rusty red best appreciated from a distance.
en.transport: Approach on the roads south of Stykkishólmur and use a legal stopping place for distant views.
en.photo: Use a telephoto composition to relate the abstract colour bands to the foot of the mountain.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 弗拉泰岛
zh.description: 布雷扎湾中的低平岛屿保有历史村落和木屋，港口、街巷与草地都适合徒步观察。
zh.transport: 从斯蒂基斯霍尔米查乘 Baldur 渡轮，出发前同时确认回程班次。
zh.photo: 从村落公路上拍成排木屋，避开私人庭院。
zh.management: 岛屿属于 Reykhólahreppur 市镇。抵达与离岛时刻由 Baldur 渡轮运营方发布。
zh.access: 村落公共路可步行。渡轮船票另付，并按班次运行。
zh.visit: 把村落步行时间排在两班可衔接的船之间，留出回码头的时间。

en.name: Flatey
en.description: This low island in Breiðafjörður retains a historic settlement and timber houses, with lanes and grassland easily explored on foot.
en.transport: Check the Baldur ferry from Stykkishólmur and confirm the return crossing before departure.
en.photo: Photograph the rows of wooden houses from the public lane, outside private yards.
en.management: The island is in Reykhólahreppur municipality. The Baldur ferry operator publishes arrival and departure schedules.
en.access: Village lanes are public. Ferry travel requires a separate ticket and runs to schedule.
en.visit: Fit the village walk between confirmed sailings and leave time to return to the dock.

zh.name: 斯沃杜瀑布
zh.description: 瀑布沿玄武岩崖跌落，柱状节理与上方雪山是这一站的地貌看点。
zh.transport: 从 574 号公路转入标示停车区，再沿步道往瀑布走。
zh.photo: 在步道上收进柱状崖壁，云层散开时可把冰川带入远景。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 574 号公路 Rif 段，Svöðufoss 停车入口

en.name: Svöðufoss
en.description: The waterfall drops over basalt. Jointed rock and the snowy mountain above are the main landscape features.
en.transport: Turn from Route 574 into the signed parking area and continue along the waterfall trail.
en.photo: Include the jointed cliff from the trail and add the glacier in the distance when clouds lift.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
en.area: Svöðufoss parking turnoff, Route 574 near Rif

zh.name: 因格亚尔德斯霍尔教堂
zh.description: 山丘上的教堂以白墙、红顶和背后的山地构图著称。今天的混凝土教堂于 1903 年落成。
zh.transport: 由海利桑德与里夫之间的 574 号公路转入教堂接驳路。
zh.photo: 在公共停车点或步行区域以长焦构图，避免站在车道上。
zh.management: 教堂仍属宗教场所，开放安排以现场教会信息为准。
zh.access: 可从户外参观，进入教堂按现场安排。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 574 号公路支路，Rif 与 Hellissandur 之间

en.name: Ingjaldshóll
en.description: The hilltop church is known for its white walls, red roof and mountain backdrop. The present concrete church dates to 1903.
en.transport: Take the church access road from Route 574 between Hellissandur and Rif.
en.photo: Compose with a longer lens from public parking or pedestrian space, clear of the road.
en.management: The church remains a place of worship. Follow local church information on indoor access.
en.access: Exterior views are available. Indoor access follows local arrangements.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
en.area: Off Route 574, between Rif and Hellissandur

zh.name: 斯卡兹维克海滩
zh.description: 淡色沙滩嵌在黑色熔岩岸之间，与半岛西端常见的深色海岸形成鲜明对比。
zh.transport: 由 574 号公路转向 Öndverðarnes 支路，使用海滩停车点。
zh.photo: 从上方步道拍浅色沙地与黑色岬角的色差。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 可从高处看沙滩色差，临海活动依现场浪况和告示调整。

en.name: Skarðsvík
en.description: Pale sand sits between dark lava headlands, a distinctive contrast on the western peninsula.
en.transport: Leave Route 574 on the Öndverðarnes road and use the beach parking area.
en.photo: Photograph the light sand and black headlands together from the upper approach.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: See the colour contrast from the upper approach and follow signs and surf conditions near the shore.

zh.name: 翁德韦达内斯灯塔
zh.description: 半岛西端的小灯塔立在荒凉熔岩岬地，鲜亮塔身与低矮黑岩相衬。
zh.transport: 从斯卡兹维克沿支路继续到尽端，检查当日路面状况。
zh.photo: 从灯塔陆地一侧拍塔身与广阔海平线。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Öndverðarnes Lighthouse
en.description: A small, brightly coloured lighthouse stands above the low, dark lava of the western headland.
en.transport: Continue past Skarðsvík to the end of the side road and check surface conditions on the day.
en.photo: Photograph the lighthouse and broad sea horizon from the landward side.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
en.area: End of the Öndverðarnes access road

zh.name: 萨克斯霍尔火山口
zh.description: 红褐色火山渣锥高出周围熔岩原，阶梯沿着火山锥坡度攀升。
zh.transport: 从 574 号公路转入火山口停车处，沿建成的阶梯上行。
zh.photo: 从指定观景区向下拍火山口，再转向拍尽头的熔岩平原。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 阶梯一路到火山口边缘，风强时可改在山脚看火山锥。

en.name: Saxhóll Crater
en.description: The reddish cinder cone rises from surrounding lava fields. A staircase follows its slope to the rim.
en.transport: Turn off Route 574 into the crater car park and take the constructed stairs.
en.photo: Photograph the crater from the designated viewpoint, then look outward across the lava plain.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: The stairs lead to the rim. In strong wind, view the cone from its base.

zh.name: 久帕隆黑石滩
zh.description: 黑色卵石、昔日渔民的举重石与 1948 年沉船残件记录了海岸地貌和渔业历史。
zh.transport: 从 574 号公路转入海滩停车区，沿指定小径下行。
zh.photo: 在高处拍卵石海湾的弧线，沉船残件可从干燥区域远拍。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 先看举重石与沉船遗迹，拍照时远离涌浪地带。

en.name: Djúpalónssandur
en.description: Black pebbles, traditional lifting stones and remains from a 1948 wreck tell the story of the shore and its fishery.
en.transport: Turn off Route 574 for the beach car park and follow the designated descent.
en.photo: Frame the curve from higher ground and photograph the wreck fragments from dry land.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Start with the lifting stones and wreck remains, and take photos clear of the reach of the surf.

zh.name: 瓦特斯赫利尔熔岩洞
zh.description: 这里保存了熔岩流留下的管道和岩壁纹理，游客随向导沿楼梯进入地下。
zh.transport: 由 574 号公路到洞口集合处，按预约时间报到。
zh.photo: 在向导允许时近拍洞壁纹理，行进中保持双手可扶梯。
zh.management: 洞穴位于国家公园内，由国家公园实施保护，洞内参观由导览运营方安排。
zh.access: 付费向导团，按预约时段开放。
zh.visit: 洞内温度偏低，穿保暖衣和抓地力良好的鞋，按向导说明使用装备。
zh.area: 574 号公路，Vatnshellir 导览集合处

en.name: Vatnshellir Cave
en.description: The cave preserves a tube left by flowing lava. Visitors descend by stairs with a guide to see the rock textures.
en.transport: Meet at the cave entrance off Route 574 at your booked time.
en.photo: Photograph the wall textures when the guide permits and keep your hands available on the stairs.
en.management: The cave is protected within the national park, with visits arranged by the guided-tour operator.
en.access: Paid guided tours operate at scheduled booking times.
en.visit: The cave stays cool. Wear warm clothing and grippy footwear and follow the guide’s equipment instructions.
en.area: Vatnshellir tour meeting point, off Route 574

zh.name: 马拉里夫灯塔
zh.description: 1946 年建成的灯塔位于开阔海岸，附近访客中心解说当地自然及渔业遗迹。
zh.transport: 从 574 号公路进入 Malarrif 访客中心停车区，徒步沿标示方向到灯塔。
zh.photo: 从远处把塔身与海岸草地一同纳入画面。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Malarrif Lighthouse
en.description: Built in 1946, the lighthouse stands on an exposed shore near the visitor centre interpreting local nature and fishing remains.
en.transport: Park at the Malarrif visitor centre off Route 574 and walk toward the lighthouse on the signed path.
en.photo: Step back on the marked path to include the lighthouse and coastal grassland.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 隆德兰加尔海蚀岩柱
zh.description: 两座岩柱从海岸突出，是侵蚀后保留下来的火山岩体。
zh.transport: 在 574 号公路的 Svalþúfa 观景停车点停靠，使用面向岩柱的步道。
zh.photo: 从护栏内用长焦拍两座岩柱与浪花，保留崖缘距离。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 574 号公路，Svalþúfa 观景停车场

en.name: Lóndrangar
en.description: Two prominent sea stacks are the volcanic rock that remains after coastal erosion.
en.transport: Use the Svalþúfa viewpoint parking off Route 574 and follow its sea-stack viewing path.
en.photo: Use a long lens from behind the barrier to frame both stacks and waves.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 斯瓦尔图法海崖
zh.description: 高地展示断崖、海鸟栖息壁和面向 Lóndrangar 的海岸线。
zh.transport: 走 574 号公路进入 Svalþúfa 停车区，再沿护栏内步道观景。
zh.photo: 沿悬崖线取斜向构图，突出岩面与大海的高差。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Svalþúfa
en.description: The headland overlooks sea cliffs, seabird habitat and the coast toward Lóndrangar.
en.transport: Pull into the Svalþúfa car park off Route 574 and use the protected viewpoint path.
en.photo: Compose diagonally along the cliff line to show its height above the sea.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 斯奈菲尔冰川
zh.description: 斯奈山半岛西端冰川覆盖火山，也是儒勒·凡尔纳《地心游记》中的地心入口。
zh.transport: 沿 574 号公路找合规停车点远观；冰川体验须另行预订合适的向导。
zh.photo: 在晴朗时以海岸熔岩地作前景，突出冰盖与山体的轮廓。
zh.management: 园方负责保护与步道维护。请查阅国家公园的路线与临时通行信息。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 半岛西端，沿 574 号公路多处可远观

en.name: Snæfellsjökull
en.description: The glacier caps the volcano at the end of the peninsula and gives Jules Verne’s Journey to the Centre of the Earth its fictional entrance.
en.transport: View the glacier from a legal stop on Route 574. Arrange a qualified guide separately for a glacier trip.
en.photo: Use coastal lava as foreground on a clear day to outline the ice cap.
en.management: The national park team oversees conservation and trail access. Check the park for route updates and temporary restrictions.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
en.area: Western tip of Snæfellsnes, visible from Route 574

zh.name: 阿尔纳斯塔皮港
zh.description: 昔日贸易港保留小港湾，沿岸柱状玄武岩与海蚀洞体现了熔岩和海浪的共同作用。
zh.transport: 从 574 号公路转入村落，在公共停车处停靠后步行到港边。
zh.photo: 从指定步道看港湾与峭壁，或将 Gatklettur 海蚀拱纳入路线。
zh.management: 海岸属于自然保护区，按冰岛自然保护署及保护区现场告示通行。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 574 号公路支路，356 Arnarstapi 港区

en.name: Arnarstapi Harbour
en.description: The former trading port retains a small harbour. Basalt columns and sea caves show how lava and waves shaped the coast.
en.transport: Leave Route 574 for the village and walk to the harbour from public parking.
en.photo: Use the marked path for harbour and cliff views, or include the Gatklettur arch on the walk.
en.management: The coast forms part of a nature reserve. Follow Nature Conservation Agency guidance and signs on site.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 海德纳尔村
zh.description: 过去的渔村坐落在海蚀岩岸上，沿湾可观察熔岩层与洞穴形成的岩壁。
zh.transport: 由 574 号公路转入海德纳尔；与阿尔纳斯塔皮连走时，先安排折返。
zh.photo: 在湾上部以岩壁作边框，让浪线延伸至画面深处。
zh.management: 海岸属于自然保护区，按冰岛自然保护署及保护区现场告示通行。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Hellnar
en.description: The former fishing village sits above an eroded shore where the bay exposes lava layers and caves.
en.transport: Take the Hellnar turnoff from Route 574. Plan the return before walking through to Arnarstapi.
en.photo: Frame the bay with rock from above and let the surf line lead into the scene.
en.management: The coast forms part of a nature reserve. Follow Nature Conservation Agency guidance and signs on site.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 布迪尔黑教堂
zh.description: 黑色木教堂立在低平熔岩地与草地之间，建筑与布迪尔旧聚落的宗教历史相连。
zh.transport: 在 54 号公路布迪尔岔口转入，使用教堂附近公共停车区。
zh.photo: 从围墙外取景，将黑色木墙与远山、浅色云层放在一起。
zh.management: 教堂是当地宗教场所。进入建筑或遇见礼拜、婚礼时，须依现场教会安排。
zh.access: 可从户外参观，内部开放依教会安排。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Búðakirkja
en.description: The black timber church stands between low lava and fields, linked to the religious history of the former Búðir settlement.
en.transport: Take the Búðir turnoff from Route 54 and use the public parking near the church.
en.photo: Frame the black wood with mountains and light cloud from outside the churchyard boundary.
en.management: The church is a local place of worship. Follow church arrangements for indoor access, services and weddings.
en.access: Exterior views are available. Indoor access follows church arrangements.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 比亚尔纳瀑布
zh.description: 瀑布从半岛南侧山壁落下，两段水流与崖壁之间的落差从公路一带即可看见。
zh.transport: 在 54 与 574 号公路交汇一带寻找专用停车点，沿步道接近。
zh.photo: 在下方步道选竖幅构图，收进岩壁和两段水流。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 54 与 574 号公路交汇附近，Bjarnarfoss 停车入口

en.name: Bjarnarfoss
en.description: The waterfall drops in two parts from the southern escarpment, with a visible change of level even from near the road.
en.transport: Use the designated car park near the Routes 54 and 574 junction and approach on the trail.
en.photo: Compose vertically from the lower path to include the escarpment and both drops.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
en.area: Bjarnarfoss parking turnoff near the Routes 54 and 574 junction

zh.name: 劳德费尔德峡谷
zh.description: 这条峡谷在 Botnsfjall 山体上形成明显纵向裂口，名字来自当地的 Bárður 萨迦。
zh.transport: 从 574 号公路进入峡谷停车区，沿坡路走到裂口前。
zh.photo: 从入口外拍峡缝与两侧岩壁，雨后优先选择干燥位置。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Rauðfeldsgjá
en.description: The ravine cuts an unmistakable vertical cleft into Botnsfjall and takes its name from the local Bárður saga.
en.transport: Use the ravine car park off Route 574 and walk up the slope to the mouth.
en.photo: Photograph the split from outside the entrance, choosing dry ground after rain.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 伊特里通加海滩
zh.description: 低潮时裸露礁石可能有海豹休息，潮位和天气会改变可观察范围。
zh.transport: 在 54 号公路按海滩路标转入停车场，然后循标示路线走向观察区。
zh.photo: 用长焦拍远处海豹，留在观察线内并让出动物通往海水的路线。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外海豹观察地，停车费以现场告示为准。
zh.visit: 低潮前后观察条件通常更好，现场有海豹时尽量保持安静。
zh.area: 54 号公路，Ytri Tunga 海滩停车入口

en.name: Ytri Tunga Beach
en.description: Seals sometimes rest on the rocks exposed at low tide, while tide and weather determine what can be seen.
en.transport: Follow the beach signs from Route 54 to parking, then take the marked approach to the watching area.
en.photo: Use a long lens from the viewing side and leave the seals a clear route to the water.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor seal-watching site. Check posted parking charges.
en.visit: Viewing is often better around low tide. Keep voices low when seals are present.
en.area: Ytri Tunga beach parking turnoff, off Route 54

zh.name: 盖尔杜贝格玄武岩柱
zh.description: 岩浆冷却收缩形成整齐的柱状节理，长段岩壁像一排并列石柱。
zh.transport: 从东南段 54 号公路转入通向岩壁的支路，停在指定空间后远望。
zh.photo: 用斜向构图表现石柱不断向远处延伸的节奏。
zh.management: 通行以入口标示为准。所附景点资料提供当地访客资讯。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: 54 号公路支路，311 Borgarnes 邮区

en.name: Gerðuberg Cliffs
en.description: Cooling lava contracted into closely spaced columns, creating a long wall of parallel basalt pillars.
en.transport: Leave the southeastern section of Route 54 on the access road and view the wall from designated parking or foot access.
en.photo: Shoot obliquely to show the repetition of the pillars into the distance.
en.management: Follow conditions posted at the access point. The linked destination listing provides local visitor information.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
en.area: Gerðuberg access road off Route 54, 311 Borgarnes area

zh.name: 厄尔凯尔达矿泉
zh.description: 含矿物质的天然泉水从农地区域的小型出水点涌出，周围沉积可见矿物作用。
zh.transport: 从 54 号公路按 Ölkelda 标示驶入，以农场入口告示为准。
zh.photo: 近拍出水点和周边沉积，取景时为后来的访客留出通道。
zh.management: 矿泉位于 Ölkelda 农场，访客通行以农场入口规则为准。
zh.access: 开放及费用依农场入口告示。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: Ölkelda 农场，54 号公路南侧

en.name: Ölkelda Mineral Spring
en.description: Mineral-rich water emerges at a small outlet on farmland, with nearby deposits showing the action of dissolved minerals.
en.transport: Follow the Ölkelda sign off Route 54 and check the instructions at the farm entrance.
en.photo: Photograph the outlet and deposits up close while keeping access clear for other visitors.
en.management: The spring is on the Ölkelda farm. The farm’s posted rules govern visitor access.
en.access: Follow the farm’s posted access and payment instructions.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 埃尔德堡火山口
zh.description: 规则的环形火山口高出熔岩平原，前往火山口的路段可以观察熔岩地表。
zh.transport: 从 54 号公路转至 Snorrastaðir，按入口标示进入火山口步道。
zh.photo: 从接近路段拍完整火山锥，至指定高处再看内壁。
zh.management: 埃尔德堡属于冰岛保护地，登山入口经过 Snorrastaðir 农场，遵从保护地与农场的标示。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。
zh.area: Snorrastaðir 步道入口，54 号公路支路

en.name: Eldborg Crater
en.description: The regular ring of the crater rises from a broad lava plain, and the approach crosses exposed lava terrain.
en.transport: Turn off Route 54 for Snorrastaðir and follow the signed trail to the crater.
en.photo: Photograph the whole cone from the approach before looking into the crater from the designated high ground.
en.management: Eldborg is a protected site. The approach crosses Snorrastaðir farmland and follows reserve and farm signs.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.

zh.name: 欧拉夫斯维克港
zh.description: 半岛北岸的渔港仍有日常装卸和渔船作业，城镇贴着陡峭山坡与狭窄湾岸展开。
zh.transport: 由 574 号公路进镇，沿公共街道步行到港边，避开作业码头。
zh.photo: 从公共海旁朝镇区拍摄，把渔船和山坡放入同一画面。
zh.management: Snæfellsbær 市镇负责当地港口服务；参观请使用公共海旁通道。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 留一段时间在公共海旁散步，观察港口日常作业。

en.name: Ólafsvík Harbour
en.description: The north-coast fishing harbour is active, with the town set between a steep slope and a narrow bay.
en.transport: Enter the town on Route 574 and walk to the harbour along public streets, clear of working quays.
en.photo: Look back toward town from the public waterfront to place fishing boats against the mountainside.
en.management: Snæfellsbær municipality provides local harbour services. Use the public waterfront paths.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Allow time for a short waterfront walk to see the working harbour.

localName: Maritime Museum in the Fishermen’s Park

zh.name: 海利桑德海事博物馆
zh.description: 渔人公园内的博物馆展示渔船及渔村生活遗存，适合了解附近居民如何靠海谋生。
zh.transport: 由 574 号公路进入海利桑德，再前往渔人公园内的博物馆。
zh.photo: 在开放的户外空间拍历史建筑与展出的渔船。
zh.management: 海事博物馆负责馆内展览与开放安排，参观前请查阅馆方资料所列的联系方式。
zh.access: 馆内开放与票价请查馆方当季安排。
zh.visit: 到馆后先看户外渔船和建筑，再按当日馆内开放情况安排参观。

en.name: Maritime Museum in the Fishermen’s Park
en.description: The museum in Fishermen’s Park displays boats and objects from fishing-village life, showing how local people made a living at sea.
en.transport: Enter Hellissandur from Route 574 and head to the museum in Fishermen’s Park.
en.photo: Frame historic buildings and the boats displayed in the public outdoor areas.
en.management: The maritime museum oversees exhibitions and admission. Check its visitor listing for current contact and opening information.
en.access: Check the museum’s seasonal opening and admission before visiting.
en.visit: Start with the boats and buildings outdoors, then visit the indoor displays if they are open.

zh.name: 加特克莱图尔海蚀拱
zh.description: 海浪侵蚀玄武岩形成带孔岩拱，近旁的岸壁仍可辨认柱状节理。
zh.transport: 在阿尔纳斯塔皮公共停车点下车，沿海岸步道走到海蚀拱观景处。
zh.photo: 从正式观景点借拱孔框住远处海面，风大时在稳固地面拍摄。
zh.management: 海岸属于自然保护区，按冰岛自然保护署及保护区现场告示通行。
zh.access: 户外游览，按入口及停车告示通行。
zh.visit: 将游览重点放在标示步道和观景点，按当日风雨及路况安排停留。

en.name: Gatklettur Sea Arch
en.description: Waves carved a window through the basalt, and columnar jointing is still visible in nearby cliffs.
en.transport: Park in Arnarstapi and follow the signed coastal path to the arch viewpoint.
en.photo: Frame the sea through the rock opening from the established viewpoint, staying on firm ground in windy conditions.
en.management: The coast forms part of a nature reserve. Follow Nature Conservation Agency guidance and signs on site.
en.access: Outdoor visit. Follow posted access and parking information.
en.visit: Use the signed path and established viewpoints, and plan the stop around the day’s weather and road conditions.
